description: This file defines utility functions and an object 'PythonUtils' for managing Python environment configurations, paths, and interactions within Apache Spark's Python API. It includes methods for constructing PYTHONPATH, generating RDDs, converting Java collections to Scala collections, logging Python environment info, and creating Python functions for Spark tasks.

classes.name: PythonUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing utility functions for managing Python environment paths, logging, and creating Python functions within Spark.

methods.name: sparkPythonPath
methods.description: Constructs the PYTHONPATH for PySpark based on SPARK_HOME environment variable and the current JAR.

methods.name: mergePythonPaths
methods.description: Merges multiple PYTHONPATH strings into a single string separated by the system's path separator.

methods.name: generateRDDWithNull
methods.description: Creates an RDD with elements 'a', null, and 'b' for testing.

methods.name: toSeq
methods.description: Converts a Java List to a Scala Seq.

methods.name: toList
methods.description: Converts a Java List to a Scala List.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts a Java List to a Scala Array.

methods.name: toScalaMap
methods.description: Converts a Java Map to a Scala Map.

methods.name: isEncryptionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if IO encryption is enabled in Spark configuration.

methods.name: getBroadcastThreshold
methods.description: Retrieves the broadcast UDF compression threshold from Spark configuration.

methods.name: getPythonAuthSocketTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the Python auth socket timeout setting.

methods.name: logPythonInfo
methods.description: Logs Python environment information including version and installed packages.

methods.name: createPythonFunction
methods.description: Creates a SimplePythonFunction object configured with the current Python environment for Spark.
